description:
Activate Undercity Scrounger by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Treasure Token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Acererak the Archlich by paying {B}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Undercity Scrounger.
Acererak the Archlich enters the battlefield and triggers, returning Acererak the Archlich to your hand and venturing into the Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Each time your trigger the Dark Pool room ability, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
